purpose: Check the positive-weight endpoint expansion for compensated logit when the limiting support has several binding directions.
controls: Every construction has three available alternatives per menu, one fitted tangent coordinate and separate labelled and auxiliary samples. Refit after an invertible coordinate change and menu translations. Use two-alternative evaluation menus whose choices expose each normal direction, plus a control with zero leading gap. The existing RADIANT and Swissmetro endpoints are prior data and are checked only for the scope of the multiface result.
